_note: Generated from IELTS_Writing_ChamDiem.xlsx / IELTS_Speaking_ChamDiem.xlsx (teacher-provided). Criterion bands are whole 1-9; overall band = rounded average.

1.en: Answer is completely unrelated to the task.
1.vi: Bài làm hoàn toàn lạc đề.

2.en: Barely responds to the task; content has little relevance; data may be presented with no clear organisation.
2.vi: Gần như không đáp ứng đề bài, tổ chức lộn xộn.

3.en: Fails to adequately address the task; does not attempt an overview; details are presented with little order, sometimes just a list of data.
3.vi: Chưa đáp ứng yêu cầu, không có tổng quan, dữ liệu rời rạc.

4.en: Attempts the task but misses key features/requirements; may confuse key features with minor details; overview is limited; some data may be inaccurate.
4.vi: Cố gắng làm bài nhưng bỏ sót đặc điểm chính, tổng quan hạn chế.

5.en: Generally addresses the task; format may be inappropriate in places; recounts details mechanically with no clear overview; may lack data to support points.
5.vi: Có làm bài nhưng thiếu tổng quan rõ ràng, trình bày máy móc.

6.en: Addresses the requirements; presents an overview with appropriately selected information; highlights key features but some details may be irrelevant or inaccurate.
6.vi: Có tổng quan, chọn thông tin phù hợp nhưng còn vài chi tiết chưa chuẩn.

7.en: Covers the requirements; presents a clear overview of main trends/differences/stages; highlights key features but details could be extended more.
7.vi: Nêu tổng quan rõ xu hướng chính, chi tiết có thể triển khai thêm.

8.en: Covers all requirements sufficiently; presents a clear overview with key features/comparisons clearly highlighted, though could be extended more fully.
8.vi: Đáp ứng đủ yêu cầu, tổng quan rõ ràng, có thể triển khai sâu hơn.

9.en: Fully satisfies all requirements; clearly presents a fully developed overview with all key features/comparisons appropriately and accurately highlighted.
9.vi: Đáp ứng trọn vẹn yêu cầu, tổng quan chính xác và đầy đủ.

1.en: Fails to communicate any message; does not respond to the task at all.
1.vi: Không truyền tải được nội dung nào.

2.en: Has very little control of organisational features.
2.vi: Hầu như không kiểm soát được cách tổ chức bài.

3.en: Does not organise ideas logically; uses a very limited range of cohesive devices which may not show a logical relationship between ideas.
3.vi: Không tổ chức ý logic, gần như không có từ nối hợp lý.

4.en: Presents ideas without coherent arrangement or clear progression; uses only basic, possibly inaccurate/repetitive cohesive devices; may not use paragraphs.
4.vi: Ý rời rạc, thiếu tiến triển rõ ràng, ít chia đoạn.

5.en: Presents information with some organisation but lacks overall progression; cohesive devices used inadequately/inaccurately/repetitively; paragraphing may be inadequate.
5.vi: Có tổ chức nhưng thiếu mạch lạc xuyên suốt, lặp từ nối.

6.en: Arranges ideas coherently with a clear overall progression; cohesive devices used effectively but sometimes mechanical; paragraphing used but not always logical.
6.vi: Sắp xếp ý khá rõ ràng nhưng liên kết đôi khi máy móc.

7.en: Logically organises information with clear progression; uses a range of cohesive devices appropriately, though with minor over-/under-use; each paragraph has a clear central topic.
7.vi: Tổ chức thông tin mạch lạc, dùng từ nối khá đa dạng.

8.en: Sequences information/ideas logically; manages all aspects of cohesion well; paragraphing is sufficient and appropriate.
8.vi: Sắp xếp ý logic, liên kết tốt, chia đoạn hợp lý.

9.en: Uses cohesion so naturally it attracts no attention; paragraphing is skilfully managed.
9.vi: Liên kết câu tự nhiên, chia đoạn khéo léo.

1.en: Can only use a few isolated words.
1.vi: Chỉ dùng được vài từ rời rạc.

2.en: Uses an extremely limited range of vocabulary; essentially no control of word formation/spelling.
2.vi: Vốn từ cực kỳ hạn chế, gần như không kiểm soát được từ.

3.en: Uses a very limited range of words/expressions with very limited control of word formation/spelling; errors may severely distort the message.
3.vi: Vốn từ rất hạn chế, lỗi làm sai lệch nghĩa nghiêm trọng.

4.en: Uses only basic vocabulary, possibly repetitive or inappropriate for the task; limited control of word formation/spelling; errors may strain the reader.
4.vi: Chỉ dùng từ cơ bản, lặp từ, lỗi ảnh hưởng người đọc.

5.en: Uses a limited range of vocabulary that is minimally adequate for the task; noticeable spelling/word-formation errors that may cause difficulty for the reader.
5.vi: Vốn từ hạn chế, lỗi chính tả/từ vựng gây khó hiểu.

6.en: Uses an adequate range of vocabulary for the task; attempts less common vocabulary with some inaccuracy; some spelling/word-formation errors that don't impede communication.
6.vi: Vốn từ đủ dùng, có cố gắng dùng từ nâng cao nhưng chưa chuẩn.

7.en: Uses a sufficient range of vocabulary allowing some flexibility and precision; uses less common items with awareness of style/collocation; occasional errors in word choice, spelling or word formation.
7.vi: Vốn từ khá đa dạng, thỉnh thoảng sai từ vựng/chính tả.

8.en: Uses a wide range of vocabulary fluently and flexibly for precise meaning; skilfully uses less common items with rare inaccuracies in word choice/collocation; rare spelling/word-formation errors.
8.vi: Vốn từ rộng, linh hoạt, hiếm lỗi chọn từ/chính tả.

9.en: Uses a wide range of vocabulary with very natural, sophisticated control; rare errors occur only as slips.
9.vi: Vốn từ rộng, dùng tự nhiên, gần như không lỗi.

1.en: Cannot use sentence forms at all.

2.en: Cannot use sentence forms except in memorised phrases.
2.vi: Chỉ dùng được câu học thuộc lòng.

3.en: Attempts sentence forms but grammar/punctuation errors predominate and distort meaning.
3.vi: Cố gắng đặt câu nhưng lỗi nhiều làm sai nghĩa.

4.en: Uses only a very limited range of structures with rare subordinate clauses; some structures accurate but errors predominate; punctuation often faulty.
4.vi: Cấu trúc rất hạn chế, lỗi ngữ pháp chiếm đa số.

5.en: Uses only a limited range of structures; attempts complex sentences but these are less accurate than simple ones; frequent grammar errors, faulty punctuation causing some difficulty.
5.vi: Cấu trúc hạn chế, câu phức thường sai, lỗi gây khó hiểu.

6.en: Uses a mix of simple and complex sentence forms; some grammar/punctuation errors but they rarely reduce communication.
6.vi: Kết hợp câu đơn và câu phức, có lỗi nhưng không cản trở giao tiếp.

7.en: Uses a variety of complex structures; produces frequent error-free sentences; good control of grammar/punctuation with a few errors.
7.vi: Dùng câu phức đa dạng, khá nhiều câu không lỗi.

8.en: Uses a wide range of structures; the majority of sentences are error-free; only very occasional errors/inappropriacies.
8.vi: Cấu trúc đa dạng, hầu hết câu không lỗi.

9.en: Uses a wide range of structures with full flexibility and accuracy; rare errors occur only as slips.
9.vi: Cấu trúc câu đa dạng, chính xác gần như tuyệt đối.

1.en: Answer is completely unrelated to the task.
1.vi: Bài làm hoàn toàn lạc đề.

2.en: Barely responds to the task; no position expressed; may attempt one or two ideas with no development.
2.vi: Gần như không trả lời đề bài.

3.en: Does not adequately address any part of the task; no clear position; few, largely undeveloped or irrelevant ideas.
3.vi: Không giải quyết được phần nào của đề bài.

4.en: Responds to the task only minimally or answers tangentially; position unclear; ideas hard to identify, may be repetitive/irrelevant/unsupported.
4.vi: Trả lời rất sơ sài hoặc lạc hướng khỏi đề.

5.en: Addresses the task only partially; format may be inappropriate; position unclear in places, no clear conclusion; main ideas limited and underdeveloped; may include irrelevant detail.
5.vi: Chỉ trả lời một phần đề, lập luận thiếu rõ ràng.

6.en: Addresses all parts although some more fully than others; presents a relevant position though conclusion may be unclear/repetitive; main ideas relevant but some underdeveloped.
6.vi: Trả lời đủ các phần nhưng chưa đều, một số ý chưa phát triển kỹ.

7.en: Addresses all parts of the task; presents a clear position throughout; extends and supports main ideas, though may over-generalise or lack focus at times.
7.vi: Trả lời đủ đề, quan điểm rõ ràng, đôi khi lập luận chưa thật sát.

8.en: Sufficiently addresses all parts of the task; presents a well-developed response with relevant, extended and supported ideas.
8.vi: Trả lời đủ các phần của đề, lập luận phát triển tốt.

9.en: Fully addresses all parts of the task; presents a fully developed position with relevant, fully extended and well-supported ideas.
9.vi: Trả lời trọn vẹn đề bài, lập luận phát triển đầy đủ, dẫn chứng thuyết phục.

1.en: No communication possible; no rateable language.

2.en: Pauses lengthily before most words; little communication possible.

3.en: Speaks with long pauses; limited ability to link simple sentences; gives only simple responses, often unable to convey the basic message.

4.en: Cannot respond without noticeable pauses, speaks slowly with frequent repetition; often self-corrects; links simple sentences but with repetitious connectives; some breakdowns in coherence.

5.en: Usually maintains flow but uses repetition/self-correction/slow speech to keep going; may overuse certain connectives; simple speech is fluent but complex ideas cause problems.

6.en: Willing to speak at length though may lose coherence at times due to repetition/self-correction/hesitation; uses connectives/discourse markers but not always appropriately.

7.en: Speaks at length without noticeable effort or loss of coherence; some language-related hesitation/repetition/self-correction; uses a range of connectives/discourse markers with some flexibility.

8.en: Speaks fluently with only occasional repetition/self-correction; hesitation is usually content-related; develops topics coherently and appropriately.

9.en: Speaks fluently with only rare repetition/self-correction; any hesitation is content-related, not language-related; fully coherent with fully appropriate cohesive features; develops topics fully.

1.en: No communication possible; no rateable language.

2.en: Only produces isolated words or memorised utterances.

3.en: Uses simple vocabulary to convey personal information; insufficient vocabulary for less familiar topics.

4.en: Can talk about familiar topics but only conveys basic meaning on unfamiliar ones, with frequent word-choice errors; rarely paraphrases.

5.en: Can talk about familiar and unfamiliar topics but with limited vocabulary flexibility; attempts paraphrase with mixed success.

6.en: Has enough vocabulary to discuss topics at length and make meaning clear despite inappropriacies; generally paraphrases successfully.

7.en: Uses vocabulary flexibly to discuss a variety of topics; uses some less common/idiomatic vocabulary with awareness of style/collocation, some inappropriate choices; paraphrases effectively.

8.en: Uses a wide vocabulary readily and flexibly for precise meaning; uses less common/idiomatic vocabulary skilfully with rare inaccuracies; paraphrases effectively.

9.en: Uses vocabulary with full flexibility and precision on all topics; uses idiomatic language naturally and accurately.

1.en: No communication possible; no rateable language.

3.en: Attempts basic sentence forms with limited success or relies on memorised utterances; numerous errors outside memorised phrases.

4.en: Produces basic sentence forms and some correct simple sentences but rarely uses subordinate structures; frequent errors may cause misunderstanding.

5.en: Produces basic sentence forms with reasonable accuracy; limited range of complex structures which usually contain errors, may cause some difficulty.

6.en: Uses a mix of simple and complex structures with limited flexibility; frequent mistakes with complex structures but these rarely cause problems understanding.

7.en: Uses a range of complex structures with some flexibility; frequently produces error-free sentences though some mistakes persist.

8.en: Uses a wide range of structures flexibly; produces mostly error-free sentences with only occasional minor errors.

9.en: Uses a full range of structures naturally and appropriately; produces consistently accurate structures apart from slips typical of native speech.

1.en: No communication possible; no rateable language.

3.en: Shows some features of Band 2 and some, but not all, positive features of Band 4.

4.en: Uses a limited range of pronunciation features; attempts control but lapses are frequent; frequent mispronunciations cause some difficulty for the listener.

5.en: Shows all positive features of Band 4 and some, but not all, positive features of Band 6.

6.en: Uses a range of pronunciation features with mixed control; effective at times but not sustained; generally understood though some words/sounds reduce clarity.

7.en: Shows all positive features of Band 6 and some, but not all, positive features of Band 8.

8.en: Uses a wide range of pronunciation features, sustained with only occasional lapses; easy to understand throughout; L1 accent minimally affects intelligibility.

9.en: Uses a full range of pronunciation features with precision and subtlety, sustained throughout; effortless to understand.
